title: Mechanistic insights into SENP1 and OCT4 interaction in promoting drug resistance and stem cell features in colon cancer.
authors: Zou, Jun; Chen, Jing; Deng, Lei; Xu, Bangran; Yu, Tenghua; Wang, Jun; He, Chongwu
journal: American journal of physiology. Cell physiology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨SENP1通过去SUMO化修饰OCT4促进结肠癌耐药和干性，虽涉及转录因子OCT4，但核心是细胞实验和测序分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: This study explores the molecular mechanism by which sentrin/SUMO-specific protease 1 (SENP1) promotes cisplatin (Cis) resistance and tumor stem cell characteristics in colon adenocarcinoma (COAD) through deSUMOylation-mediated modification of octamer-binding transcription factor 4 (OCT4). By analyzing single-cell and transcriptome sequencing datasets, we identified key genes and regulatory pathways in both resistant and sensitive COAD cells. Malignant cells were isolated and evaluated for stemness using the infercnv package, and differential genes between Cis-resistant and -sensitive groups were identified. Machine learning algorithms highlighted essential genes, and databases predicted interaction sites between OCT4 and SENP1. In vitro experiments using enriched HCT116 stem cells revealed that SENP1 and OCT4 expression significantly elevated CD44 and CD133 levels, enhancing stemness. Functional assays showed that SENP1's deSUMOylation of OCT4 intensified Cis resistance, migration, and invasion in cisplatin-resistant cell line 116 (Cis-116) cells. In vivo, SENP1 knockdown reduced tumor growth and stem cell markers, whereas OCT4 overexpression escalated tumor metastasis and structural damage. These findings demonstrate that SENP1's modulation of OCT4 is central to COAD's resistance and stem cell properties, offering a novel target for COAD therapy.NEW & NOTEWORTHY This study uncovers the critical role of SENP1 in regulating OCT4 through deSUMOylation, driving Cis resistance and tumor stemness in COAD. Targeting this pathway may provide novel therapeutic strategies for COAD management.
abstract_zh:
本研究探讨了sentrin/SUMO特异性蛋白酶1（SENP1）通过去SUMO化修饰八聚体结合转录因子4（OCT4）促进结肠腺癌（COAD）中顺铂（Cis）耐药及肿瘤干细胞特性的分子机制。通过分析单细胞和转录组测序数据集，我们鉴定了耐药和敏感COAD细胞中的关键基因及调控通路。利用infercnv包分离恶性细胞并评估其干性，同时鉴定了Cis耐药组与敏感组之间的差异基因。机器学习算法突出了关键基因，数据库预测了OCT4与SENP1之间的相互作用位点。使用富集的HCT116干细胞进行的体外实验显示，SENP1和OCT4表达显著升高CD44和CD133水平，增强了干性。功能实验表明，SENP1对OCT4的去SUMO化作用加剧了顺铂耐药细胞系116（Cis-116）细胞的Cis耐药性、迁移和侵袭。在体内，SENP1敲低减少了肿瘤生长和干细胞标志物，而OCT4过表达则加剧了肿瘤转移和结构损伤。这些发现证明，SENP1对OCT4的调控是COAD耐药及干细胞特性的核心机制，为COAD治疗提供了新靶点。

新意与重要性 本研究揭示了SENP1通过去SUMO化调控OCT4的关键作用，驱动COAD中的Cis耐药和肿瘤干性。靶向该通路可能为COAD管理提供新的治疗策略。
